'''Koki Kofuns''' (小木古墳群, ''Koki Kofungun'') are a group of [[kofun]] (ancient Kofuns) from the [[Kofun period]] located in the Koki district in the western part of {{ill|Komaki|en|Komaki|qid=Q389537|lt=Komaki|1=Komaki}}, {{ill|Aichi Prefecture|en|Aichi Prefecture|qid=Q80434|lt=Aichi Prefecture|1=Aichi Prefecture}}. Although no formal archaeological survey has been conducted, the artifacts unearthed suggest they date to the late {{ill|3rd century|en|3rd century|qid=Q8101|lt=3rd century|1=3rd century}} to the {{ill|4th century|en|4th century|qid=Q8099|lt=4th century|1=4th century}}.

==History==

* Late {{ill|3rd century|en|3rd century|qid=Q8101|lt=3rd century|1=3rd century}} to {{ill|4th century|en|4th century|qid=Q8099|lt=4th century|1=4th century}}: Construction of the Kofuns.
* {{ill|September 9|en|September 9|qid=Q2856|lt=September 9|1=September 9}}, {{ill|1987|en|1987|qid=Q2429|lt=1987|1=1987}} ({{ill|Shōwa|en|Shōwa|qid=Q398996|lt=Shōwa|1=Shōwa}} 62): The {{ill|Utsunomiya Shrine (Komaki City)|ja|宇都宮神社 (小牧市)|lt=Utsunomiya Shrine|lt=Utsunomiya Shrine Kofun|lt_ja=宇都宮神社古墳|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Utsunomiya Shrine (Komaki City)|1=Utsunomiya Shrine|comment=changed title based on wikidata|qid=Q11449800}} was designated as a tangible {{ill|Cultural property|en|Cultural property|qid=Q2065736|lt=Cultural property|1=Cultural property}} by {{ill|Aichi Prefecture|en|Aichi Prefecture|qid=Q80434|lt=Aichi Prefecture|1=Aichi Prefecture}}.
* {{ill|August 15|en|August 15|qid=Q2774|lt=August 15|1=August 15}}, {{ill|1992|en|1992|qid=Q2060|lt=1992|1=1992}} ([[:en:Heisei|Heisei]] 4): The {{ill|Kōyashiki Kofun|ja|甲屋敷古墳|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Kōyashiki Kofun|qq=}} was designated as a cultural property by [[Komaki City]].
